items.name: President of the United States
items.mission: Heads the executive branch, implements the laws, conducts executive foreign relations, and serves as Commander in Chief within constitutional limits.

items.name: Vice President of the United States
items.mission: Performs presidential succession and constitutional roles as President of the Senate, including casting tie-breaking votes.
items.notes: Constitutionally straddles executive succession and Senate presiding functions; branch classification is not exclusive to every function.

items.name: Executive Office of the President
items.mission: Supports the President through policy coordination, budget management, national-security advice, and executive administration.

items.name: Office of Management and Budget
items.mission: Budget formulation, management and regulatory review support for the President.

items.name: National Security Council
items.mission: Advises and assists the President on national security and foreign-policy integration.

items.name: Office of Science and Technology Policy
items.mission: Provides science and technology policy advice and coordination to the President.

items.name: Office of the United States Trade Representative
items.mission: Develops and coordinates U.S. international trade policy and negotiations under presidential direction.

items.name: Council of Economic Advisers
items.mission: Provides economic research and advice to the President.

items.name: Office of the National Cyber Director
items.mission: Coordinates executive national cybersecurity policy and strategy.

items.name: Council on Environmental Quality
items.mission: Advises and coordinates environmental policy and related executive responsibilities.
